synthesis.body: tools/catalogue/sync_authoring_scaffold.py --check compared repo-root bytes to the _data/ projection but never verified the SHA-256s it writes into manifest.json. Adopter-side catalogue init verifies those hashes and fails on a mismatch, so the gate reported ok while adopters broke. When a --write mode emits a digest file, its --check mode must recompute and compare that digest, not just the source content.

title: A sync --check that compares content can still pass on a stale manifest
